IDF: Approximately 200 meters from UN posts in southern Lebanon: An apartment used for military purposes by Hezbollah and dozens of weapons were located within a civilian residence and a storage facility

Troops of the 91st Division are operating in the Security Zone in southern Lebanon to remove threats to the State of Israel.

During operations by the 'Oded' (9th) Brigade Combat Team in the area of Meiss El Jabal, two stockpiles of equipment and weapons were located in a civilian home situated approximately 200 meters from a UN post, and in a storage facility located approximately 100 meters from a UN post. Among the weapons located: Kalashnikov rifles, RPG launchers and rockets, a PK machine gun, fragmentation grenades, an explosive device, ammunition, and communications and surveillance equipment. These were found alongside humanitarian aid boxes and emblems of the Amal and Hezbollah terrorist organizations.

Additionally, during operations by the Kfir Brigade Combat Team in the area of Et Tiri, an apartment used for military purposes by Hezbollah was located approximately 250 meters from a UN post, containing surveillance equipment, combat gear, living supplies, and emblems of the Hezbollah terrorist organization.

This is further evidence that the UNIFIL force has failed in its mission, and of the cynical exploitation by terrorist organizations in the face of UNIFIL's inaction.

The IDF will not allow the Hezbollah terrorist organization to harm Israeli civilians and ID

tg:manniefabian/59491.text:
The Israel Police and Shin Bet security agency are investigating flyers found in Tel Aviv today, tied to an Iran-linked hacker group.

The flyers, which feature a QR code, were found in mailboxes at several addresses in northern Tel Aviv, according to the police.

Police say the QR code linked to a webpage containing "threatening content."

A screenshot shared by police shows that the website is titled "warning from handala team," a hacker group linked to Iran that has previously published the contents from the devices of Israeli officials.

The site includes a message in broken Hebrew warning Israelis that if "your leaders once again act foolishly and attack the energy infrastructure of the resistance front, you must be prepared to pay the heavy price for this aggression."

"On that day, not a single power station, oil refinery or water desalination facility will remain in the occupied territories. From south to north, your energy and water arteries will shatter like glass," the message reads.

"This is the final warning. The choice is yours: wisdom, or sinking into darkness and the silence of catastrophe," the website reads.

Police say that officers arrived at the addresses in Tel Aviv and collected the flyers as evidence for an investigation, which the Shin Bet is also taking part in.
tg:manniefabian/59491.fa: پلیس اسرائیل و آژانس امنیتی شین بت در حال بررسی بروشورهایی هستند که امروز در تل آویو پیدا شده اند که مربوط به یک گروه هکری مرتبط با ایران است. به گفته پلیس، بروشورها که دارای یک کد QR هستند، در صندوق‌های پستی در چندین آدرس در شمال تل آویو پیدا شده اند. پلیس می‌گوید که کد QR به یک صفحه وب حاوی "محتوای تهدید آمیز" مرتبط است. اسکرین شات به اشتراک گذاشته شده توسط پلیس نشان می‌دهد که این وب سایت "هشدار تیم هندلا" نام دارد، یک گروه هکر مرتبط با ایران که قبلاً محتوای دستگاه‌های مقامات اسرائیلی را منتشر کرده است. این سایت حاوی پیامی به زبان عبری شکسته است که به اسرائیلی‌ها هشدار می‌دهد که «اگر رهبران شما بار دیگر احمقانه عمل کنند و به زیرساخت‌های انرژی جبهه مقاومت حمله کنند، باید آماده باشید تا بهای سنگین این تجاوز را بپردازید». در این پیام آمده است: «در آن روز حتی یک نیروگاه، پالایشگاه نفت یا تأسیسات نمک‌زدایی آب در سرزمین‌های اشغالی باقی نمی‌ماند. از جنوب تا شمال، شریان‌های انرژی و آب شما مانند شیشه می‌شکند». این وب سایت می‌نویسد: "این آخرین هشدار است. انتخاب با شماست: خرد، یا فرو رفتن در تاریکی و سکوت فاجعه." پلیس می‌گوید که افسران به آدرس‌های تل آویو رسیدند و آگهی‌ها را به عنوان مدرکی برای تحقیقات جمع آوری کردند که شین بت نیز در آن شرکت دارد.
tg:manniefabian/59491.en:
The Israel Police and Shin Bet security agency are investigating flyers found in Tel Aviv today, tied to an Iran-linked hacker group.

The flyers, which feature a QR code, were found in mailboxes at several addresses in northern Tel Aviv, according to the police.

Police say the QR code linked to a webpage containing "threatening content."

A screenshot shared by police shows that the website is titled "warning from handala team," a hacker group linked to Iran that has previously published the contents from the devices of Israeli officials.

The site includes a message in broken Hebrew warning Israelis that if "your leaders once again act foolishly and attack the energy infrastructure of the resistance front, you must be prepared to pay the heavy price for this aggression."

"On that day, not a single power station, oil refinery or water desalination facility will remain in the occupied territories. From south to north, your energy and water arteries will shatter like glass," the message reads.

"This is the final warning. The choice is yours: wisdom, or sinking into darkness and the silence of catastrophe," the website reads.

Police say that officers arrived at the addresses in Tel Aviv and collected the flyers as evidence for an investigation, which the Shin Bet is also taking part in.

The military says the man was located by United Nations forces near the border and handed over to IDF troops, who escorted him back to Israeli territory.

The IDF says the incident is under further investigation.

The commander of the US Navy’s 5th Fleet, the naval component in the US Central Command, completed a visit to Israel this week.

During the visit, 5th Fleet commander Vice Adm. Curt Renshaw met with Israeli Navy chief Vice Adm. Eyal Harel and other top naval officers, the Israeli military says.

"The commanders discussed the Navy’s actions during operations across the various arenas, strengthening the partnership to maintain regional stability and the security of maritime routes, mutual coordination between the fleets, and technological knowledge-sharing," the IDF says in a statement.

The 5th Fleet is headquartered in Bahrain and has been involved in low-level fighting against Iran in the Gulf and Strait of Hormuz in recent months, amid an American naval blockade of Iranian ports.
